name: postiz-app
description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
one_liner: A free tool for planning, scheduling, and posting your content to all your social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and more) from one calendar, with AI help built in.
buyer: A social media manager or small marketing agency juggling multiple clients' accounts who currently pays for Buffer or Hootsuite seats per client.
business_use_cases: A freelance social media manager self-hosts it to run every client's scheduling from one dashboard instead of paying per-seat SaaS fees that eat their margin.
A small e-commerce brand schedules a month of posts across every platform in one sitting and lets the agentic features draft caption variants.
A local business consultant offers 'social media on autopilot' as a flat monthly add-on to existing marketing retainers, powered entirely by this free self-hosted tool.

money_ideas.idea: Self-host it and resell managed social scheduling to small local businesses as a monthly service.
Offer one-time setup and multi-account integration for agencies migrating off paid schedulers.

steal_this: Self-host it this weekend, connect one local business's social accounts, and schedule their next two weeks of posts as a free trial to land a retainer.
